registration.selection_basis: Exploratory roll_conflict signal identified before this registry. No post-registration threshold, holding-period, direction, or execution-model refit is permitted in v1.

execution.fee_source: market observed fee_rate_bps/fee_exponent when present; crypto fallback only if the production row lacks parameters
execution.fee_formula: fee_usdc = shares * fee_rate * p * (1-p), each taker match, rounded to 5 decimals for the precision stress view
execution.partial_fill_assumption: no synthetic partial fills; insufficient displayed capacity is a rejected attempt
execution.missing_exit_policy: retain attempt as unvalued and charge worst-case capital loss in lower-bound ledger

confidence.multiple_testing_method: single pre-registered primary; no within-v1 winner reselection

notes: The forward boundary is a window-start boundary, not a row receive-time filter. Entire windows starting before it are excluded from forward returns.
All causal warm-up observations may be read, but no pre-boundary outcome contributes to v1 performance statistics.
Real trading remains disabled. This registry can only support a later recommendation for manual review.
